properties.abstract: This circular hike from Langenbruck combines nature, culture and history. It leads from Schönthal Monastery over ridge trails with stunning views to the Hauenstein Fortifications and on to the Belchenflue, with a fantastic panoramic view to the Alps.
properties.description:
The varied circular hike begins in the pass village of Langenbruck. The path firstly takes you along the Chräiegg to the impressive Schönthal Monastery. The former Benedictine monastery is among the most important cultural monuments in the Basel region and is now a vibrant cultural meeting place, with a sculpture park surrounded by nature. 

The subsequent climb comes with far-reaching views of rolling hills and across to the Alps. From Humbel, the views open up – the panorama now stretches across Basel and the Swiss Plateau to the distant mountain chains. The ridge trail requires a degree of surefootedness at the start but boasts varied pathways, quiet passages through forests and ever-changing views.

On the First World War memorial trail between Lauchflue and Belchenflue, 12 information boards recount the history and importance of the Hauenstein Fortifications. They provide insights into the First World War in Switzerland and show the impact on society and daily life.

After the historic trenches at Spitzenflüeli, the path takes you via the Chilchzimmersattel pass up to Belchenflue, the highest point of the tour. The viewing point, which was once a lookout in the First World War, has an impressive, unrivalled view over the Basel region to Germany, France and towards the Alps. On the Belchensüdstrasse road, restored coats of arms, stone reliefs and engraved regiment inscriptions are a reminder of the Landwehr troops who were stationed here during the First World War. 

The cosy Dürstel mountain restaurant on the descent to Langenbruck is a good spot to take a break. You can enjoy regional and seasonal specialities on the terrace or in the cosy indoor restaurant. It’s worth stopping for longer in Langenbruck: The toboggan run and rope park promise action, while there are also many other appealing scenic hikes. An overnight stay in the historic Hotel Erica rounds off the hike.
properties.title: Langenbruck Belchenfluh Rundweg
